profile.bio:
Hi, I’m Aditya 👋

I’m a Computer Science and Engineering student at VIT Vellore, specialising in Blockchain Technology, with a strong interest in building intelligent and scalable solutions for real-world problems.

My technical interests include Blockchain, Smart Contracts, Decentralised Systems, AI & Generative AI, Python, and Java. I’m also exploring emerging tools, technologies, and prompt engineering frameworks to build smarter and more efficient applications.

I believe in learning by building — experimenting with new technologies, developing practical projects, and continuously improving my problem-solving and technical skills.

Exploring. Building. Learning. Innovating.

projects.title: AI-Based Hiring Intelligence Platform
projects.subtitle: ML-powered recruitment system predicting candidate suitability & job alignment
projects.description: An end-to-end machine learning web platform that optimizes recruitment workflows. Leverages Scikit-Learn predictive models and label encoding to evaluate candidate experience, education, and skill metrics to assist recruiters in making data-driven hiring decisions.

projects.title: EcoTrack: Carbon Footprint Awareness Platform
projects.subtitle: Interactive sustainability & emissions tracking platform for individuals & campuses
projects.description: An interactive sustainability platform built to measure and reduce environmental impact. Features real-time carbon footprint calculation across transportation, energy, and dietary habits, coupled with tailored action plans for individuals and institutions.

projects.title: VoxPoll: Polling & Real-Time Visualization Platform
projects.subtitle: High-throughput online survey & polling platform with dynamic live charting
projects.description: An advanced online polling engine featuring secure participant authentication, instant vote aggregation, and real-time result visualization with responsive Chart.js data graphs and an admin management dashboard.

projects.title: Fake Job Posting Detection System
projects.subtitle: NLP & ML scam detection system trained on 17,800+ job postings with 98% accuracy
projects.description: A fraud-prevention machine learning system that classifies job postings as real or fraudulent. Employs text cleaning, TF-IDF n-gram vectorization, and multi-model benchmarking (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Linear SVM) to detect fraudulent hiring patterns.
